The Night Market


Every night the honest merchants shut their doors, and people like me open ours. I set up here at nightfall and I'm gone before the sun can find me.

Sealed Caches - the same caches the monsters leave behind. Open one and see what's inside.

Luminous lures - they only work at night. The fishermen sell the plain ones; the low and high grades you only find here.

The night has other dealers too. Look for the shady stores that open in town after dark: they sell things cheap and never say where they got them. And watch the Thieves out in the wild - at night they don't stick around to be caught.
